description: This file defines the 'ClaimExpense' class, an entity representing an expense claim within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes properties such as expense type, date, amount, note, and associated claim request, with ORM mappings for database persistence.

classes.name: ClaimExpense
classes.description: An entity class representing a claim expense record in the database with properties such as expense type, date, amount, note, and related claim request.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the claim expense.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the claim expense.

methods.name: getExpenseType
methods.description: Returns the expense type associated with the expense.

methods.name: setExpenseType
methods.description: Sets the expense type for this expense record.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date the expense was incurred.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date the expense was incurred.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the amount of the expense.

methods.name: setAmount
methods.description: Sets the amount of the expense.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns any note associated with the expense.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets a note for the expense.

methods.name: getClaimRequest
methods.description: Returns the claim request associated with this expense.

methods.name: setClaimRequest
methods.description: Associates a claim request with this expense.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks whether the expense is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setIsDeleted
methods.description: Marks the expense as deleted or not.
